title: Interior multi-storey atrium with central stair and balconies
objects_and_counts: No people are visible in the photographed scene.
A multi-storey atrium with at least three visible levels (ground plus two upper floors) is present.
One vertical stairwell is visible on the right side of the atrium, showing at least three stair flights within that stairwell (each flight between landings is visible).
At least four large vertical structural columns are visible across the front of the atrium; several additional columns are partially visible behind or at image edges.
Multiple horizontal balcony/railing runs are visible on each level; individual rail segments are visible but an exact count of rail segments or balcony openings cannot be determined from the image.

A rectangular recessed floor area or sunken courtyard is visible in the foreground; it contains what appear to be small circular features (possibly drains or fixtures) but these features are partially obscured and cannot be reliably counted.
Multiple window openings and wall panels are visible along the interior facades; exact counts of windows and panels cannot be reliably determined from this single view.
A patterned brick or lattice panel is visible on the lower left interior wall (one large panel assembly is visible).

Two large stylized text graphics are overlaid on the image (these are printed on the image and not part of the photographed architecture): one reading "THE LIBRARY" near the lower left and two ribbon-like buttons on the lower right reading "START" and "TUTORIAL".

The stairwell is located to the right of center and runs vertically, with stair flights and landings visible between each floor level; the stairwell is enclosed by columns and open balustrades toward the atrium.
Balconies with railings run along the front of each upper level, directly behind the row of vertical columns.
The rectangular recessed area or sunken courtyard is in the foreground, directly in front of the lowest level and bounded by a raised walkway or edge on at least two sides.
The patterned brick/lattice panel is mounted on the lower left interior wall, below the second level of balconies.

The overlaid text graphics are superimposed on the image: "THE LIBRARY" is overlaid at lower left atop the foreground area, while "START" and "TUTORIAL" are overlaid at lower right on ribbon-like shapes.
